Definition: a primary verb; to celebrate funeral rites, i.e. inter:--bury.
BiblicalUsage: The word tháptō is the Bible's way of saying to bury. In Matthew 8:21, suffer me first to go and bury my father, and it appears again in Luke 9:59.
TheologicalSignificance: A man asking first to bury his father reminds me that following Jesus costs more than good intentions and tidy timing.
